title: Cross-customer authority
scenario: Agent attempts action against a different tenant record
rating_rationale: Requires organization exposure, likelihood and impact evidence; no numeric score invented

title: Altered approval
scenario: Agent substitutes amount or resource state after review
rating_rationale: Requires organization exposure, likelihood and impact evidence; no numeric score invented
control: One-use expiring approval bound to action and source versions

title: Untrusted or stale facts
scenario: KYC or policy facts are stale or unavailable
rating_rationale: Requires organization exposure, likelihood and impact evidence; no numeric score invented
control: Authoritative context freshness, expiry and hard-deny behavior
assurance_status: Synthetic facts only; real sources open

title: Excessive aggregate exposure
scenario: Concurrent small actions exceed delegated tenant budget
rating_rationale: Requires organization exposure, likelihood and impact evidence; no numeric score invented

title: Enforcement bypass
scenario: Agent obtains direct target credentials or a second write path
rating_rationale: Requires organization exposure, likelihood and impact evidence; no numeric score invented
control: Network isolation, workload identity, adapter-exclusive credentials

title: Misleading human review
scenario: Plausible narrative causes a reviewer to approve an unsuitable action
rating_rationale: Requires organization exposure, likelihood and impact evidence; no numeric score invented
control: Review authoritative facts and alternatives; independent challenge

title: Unfair or inaccurate credit result
scenario: Model or data produces discriminatory or incorrect recommendation
rating_rationale: Requires organization exposure, likelihood and impact evidence; no numeric score invented
control: Independent credit-model and group fairness validation
evidence_test: Representative labeled data and Fairlearn evaluation required

title: Evidence compromise
scenario: Privileged database operator rewrites evidence and recomputes hashes
rating_rationale: Requires organization exposure, likelihood and impact evidence; no numeric score invented
control: External signed checkpoints, segregated WORM archive and reconciliation
evidence_test: External anchoring and retention test required
assurance_status: Local chain detects edits only; admin tamper unresolved

title: Governance service outage
scenario: Fail-closed controls interrupt an important business service
rating_rationale: Requires organization exposure, likelihood and impact evidence; no numeric score invented
control: Impact tolerance, queue limits, manual fallback and recovery drills

title: Downstream inconsistent outcome
scenario: Target commits but remote response is lost
rating_rationale: Requires organization exposure, likelihood and impact evidence; no numeric score invented
control: Target idempotency, expected-version commit, outbox and reconciliation
evidence_test: Synthetic atomicity tested; real adapter fault injection required

title: Sensitive records exposed
scenario: Prompts, traces or source references leak personal data
rating_rationale: Requires organization exposure, likelihood and impact evidence; no numeric score invented
control: Minimized event schema, retention, access and purpose controls
assurance_status: Partial; identifiers and hashes remain sensitive

title: Compromised dependency
scenario: Tool, model, policy or package supply chain changes behavior
rating_rationale: Requires organization exposure, likelihood and impact evidence; no numeric score invented
control: Pinned digests, SBOM, review, scanning, signed rollout and revocation
